entities.name: Bernatheen
entities.description: A manipulative Wizard Savant of the Floating Island who made Eron the Relentless immortal and was turned into a werewolf by Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Persuaded by Bernatheen to steal a spellbook; made immortal.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Punished Bernatheen by turning him into a greater werewolf.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Owner of the library from which a spellbook was stolen.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Dwarf who later held the position of Wizard Savant.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Established the Wizards' School on the Floating Island.

entities.name: Floating Island
entities.description: Stable hub of magic and trade centered on the Wizards' School.

entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: School established by Feroz on the Floating Island.

events.summary: Bernatheen persuades Eron to steal a spellbook from Grandmother Sengir's library, promising a powerful spell.
events.quote: Bernatheen's promise to cast a powerful spell in exchange for this theft led to Eron's immortality

events.summary: Baron Sengir punishes Bernatheen by transforming him into a greater werewolf.
events.quote: Bernatheen was transformed into a greater werewolf by the Baron
